# @graphyn/tbh (tbh-md) llms.txt

## Repository Identity
- Project: `@graphyn/tbh`
- Type: Discovery web app + distributable CLI
- Primary role: open-source discovery/install surface for Graphyn modes, lenses, skills, and MCP listings

## Backbone Operating Line
- Wiring-first: install flows must remain executable without fabricated backend success.
- Evidence-before-assertion: validate CLI and static artifact behavior with real commands.
- Goal-first execution: isolate changes to catalog, install runtime, or UI route scope.

## Stack
- React 19 + TypeScript + Vite
- Static catalog/artifact serving from `public/`
- CLI build output under `cli-dist/` with launcher `bin/cli.mjs`

## Critical Paths
- `src/cli.ts`
- `src/cli/commands/*`
- `src/cli/runtime/*`
- `src/core/providers/*`
- `public/catalog/`, `public/artifacts/`, `public/manifests/`
- `scripts/generate-catalog-indexes.mjs`

## Install Strategy Contract (Static-First)
1. Optional API path (`TBH_INSTALL_API_BASE`) when configured and healthy
2. Static artifact resolution
3. Generated install document fallback

## Environment Contract
- Web: `VITE_TBH_CATALOG_URL`
- CLI: `TBH_CATALOG_URL`, `TBH_ARTIFACT_BASE_URL`, `TBH_INSTALL_TARGET`, `TBH_INSTALL_API_BASE`, `TBH_INSTALL_DIR`

## Local Commands
- Install: `pnpm install`
- Web dev: `pnpm run dev`
- Web build: `pnpm run build`
- CLI build: `pnpm run build:cli`
- Full build: `pnpm run build:all`
- CLI run: `node cli-dist/cli.js --help`
- Catalog refresh: `pnpm run generate:catalog`

## Agent Workflow Checklist
1. Preserve backend-optional install behavior.
2. Update static manifests/artifacts when command behavior changes.
3. Run `pnpm run build` and `pnpm run build:cli` for release-impacting changes.
4. Validate key commands (`find`, `view`, `install`) after edits.

## Dependency Docs (Reference)
- React docs: https://react.dev/
- Vite docs: https://vite.dev/guide/
- TypeScript docs: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/
- pnpm docs: https://pnpm.io/
- npm package `bin` docs: https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/package-json#bin

## Execution Guardrails
- Keep published CLI contract stable (`tbh` binary + command semantics).
- Preserve artifact integrity metadata (`integrity`/SHA-256 expectations).
- Do not make API availability a hard requirement for install.
